summary: T1 item 2 (Layout, analog), r4: GDS generated by layout/gen_driver_pad.py from the stock sky130_ef_io__analog_noesd_pad frame plus klt gen cells; byte-identical on re-run (verification/signoff/check-driver-pad-gds.sh passes). The driver is routed from its netlist (issue #48); ddr_mux and predriver are placement plus supply routing only (VCCD/VDDIO/VSSIO strapped across the pad frame and blocks, issue #74), with signal nets unrouted. The D1 pad diode and a true thick-oxide ESD clamp are deferred (see layout/README.md). The routed driver now also carries a met3 label on each slice's DR-008 pad-facing PMOS well net (xsl_*/WELL; labels only, no geometry that touches an n-well, issue #77). Supersedes item-2-layout-analog-r3.json (kept as history, bound to the GDS before issue #77). No DRC or LVS is claimed clean here; see items 3 and 4
